link_lists_to_update.description: Indicates that the system is to update an address space or the specified job or jobs to use the current LNKLST set. Otherwise, if the job is using another LNKLST set when the current LNKLST set is activated, it will continue to use the previous LNKLST set until it completes operations. When the job completes and restarts, the job then uses the data sets defined in the new currently active LNKLST set.

require_copy_from.$comment: This indicates that we need to specify on link_list.lists_to_define` a specific value if a value is present here.
require_copy_from.description:
Indicates that a `link_list.lists_to_define` (LNKLST DEFINE) statement, or SETPROG LNKLST,DEFINE command must specify, or must not specify the COPYFROM or NOCOPYFROM keyword.
`require_copy_from: true` (REQCOPYFROM, or REQCF), indicates that the COPYFROM keyword must be specified.
`require_copy_from: false` (NOREQCOPYFROM, or NOREQCF), indicates that the NOCOPYFROM keyword must be specified.

copy_from_current.$comment: This indicates that we need to specify on link_list.lists_to_define` a specific value if a value is present here.
copy_from_current.description:
Indicates that a `link_list.lists_to_define` (LNKLST DEFINE) statement, or SETPROG LNKLST,DEFINE command must specify, or must not specify COPYFROM(CURRENT).
If `defaults.link_lists.copy_from_current: true` (DEFAULTS LNKLST COPYFROMCUR) is specified and `defaults.link_lists.require_copy_from: true` (LNKLST DEFAULTS REQCOPYFROM) is specified, the COPYFROM keyword does not have to be specified with the LNKLST DEFINE statement.
`copy_from_current: true` (COPYFROMCUR, or CFCUR), indicates that the COPYFROM(CURRENT) keyword must be specified.
`copy_from_current: false` (NOCOPYFROMCUR, or NOCFCUR), indicates that the COPYFROM(CURRENT) keyword must not be specified.

1-8 character mask that is to be applied to all the members of the specified data set. It can contain wildcard characters "*" and "?" and all members that match will be processed.

disk_name.description:
The name of the volume on which the data set resides. The name can be from 1 to 6 characters.
You can use a value of ****** to indicate that the data set is located on the current SYSRES volume. You can use a value of "*MCAT*" to indicate that the data set is located on the volume containing the IPL-time master catalog. You can use &SYSR1 to indicate the system residence volume.

pageable.description: Indicates whether the modules are to be placed in fixed or pageable storage.

page_protect_by_page.description:
When True (PAGEPROTPAGE is requested), only the whole pages within each load module are page protected, which keeps the storage use to the minimum amount but which makes it possible that a storage overlay of the beginning or end of the load module can occur.
Default, or false, is to protect the modules entirely.

entry_within_svc_table_to_update.desription:
Identifies the entry within the SVC Table to update.
For an extended SVC (109, 116, 122, 137), you must specify the routcode, which is the extended SVC routing code. The routcode must be within the range that is supported by the SVC. For example, for SVC 109, the routcode must be from 0 - 255. The routcode for other extended SVC number depends on the release of z/OS®.
Use the SVCNUMDEC function for updating already-defined SVC Table entries. Do not use this to create new entries in the SVC Table, as you might not get all of the attributes that you need.

mvs_file_options.description:
Can use `use_link_list: true` or `data_set_name: fully.qualified.data.set.name`

add_alias.description: True indicates to process provided names and aliases of the provided names. False (default specification) indicates to process only the names provided (not aliases). This overrides the setting at `defaults.link_pack_area.add_alias`

apf_required.description:
True indicates that the specified data set (or for the LNKLST when LNKAUTH-APFTAB is in effect, the module's data set) must be APF-authorized.
False indicates that the data set need not be APF-authorized.
True indicates that, by default, the data set specified for LPA ADD must be APF-authorized. APFREQ does not apply if the data set is specified as LNKLST which indicates that the LNKLST concatenation is to be used. False indicates that, by default, the data set need not be APF-authorized.

logical_unit_name.description: (ACBNAME) The name of the local LU. This name must match the VTAM LU definition. The name must be 1-8 alphanumeric characters.

scheduler_name.description: (SCHED) The name of the transaction scheduler to be associated with this LU. Mutually exclusive with no_scheduler. If neither is specified, the default APPC/MVS transaction scheduler (ASCH) is used.

no_scheduler.description: (NOSCHED) Indicates that no transaction scheduler is associated with this LU. Mutually exclusive with scheduler_name. When true, the LU cannot be used for inbound allocate requests.

is_base_lu.description: (BASE) Designates this LU as the base LU for the APPC/MVS configuration. Only one LU should be designated as the base LU. The base LU is used for system-level APPC/MVS functions.

persistence_timer.description: (PSTIMER) The length of time (in seconds) that sessions persist after all conversations on the session have ended. This allows sessions to be reused for subsequent conversations, improving performance. A value of 0 means sessions are deactivated immediately.

tp_profile_dataset.description: (TPDATA) The name of the TP profile file (dataset) associated with this LU. The TP profile file contains transaction program definitions. The dataset must be a VSAM KSDS and must be cataloged.

tp_search_level.description: (TPLEVEL) The level at which APPC/MVS searches for TP profile definitions. SYSTEM searches only the system-level TP profile file. GROUP searches the system-level file and the LU-level file. USER searches all three levels (system, LU, and user).

alternate_lu_data.description: (ALTLU) Optional installation-supplied data passed to an alternate transaction scheduler. The format and content of this data is determined by the specific scheduler implementation.

user_variable.description: (USERVAR) Optional installation-supplied user variable passed to an alternate transaction scheduler. The format and content of this variable is determined by the specific scheduler implementation.

generic_resource_name.description: (GRNAME) The VTAM generic resource name to be associated with this LU. This allows multiple LUs to be accessed through a single generic name for workload balancing. The name must match a VTAM generic resource definition.

use_network_qualified_name.description: (NQN/NONQN) Specifies whether the LU is enabled to use a network-qualified partner LU name when first allocating an outbound conversation. When true (NQN), network-qualified names are used. When false (NONQN), network-qualified names are not used.

delete_logical_unit_statements.description: (LUDEL) statements delete local LUs from the APPC/MVS configuration. When a LUDEL statement is processed, new allocation requests to the named LU are rejected, but existing conversations continue until completed. The LU is removed only after all conversations have ended. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=appcpmxx-deleting-local-lu-ludel-statement

logical_unit_name.description: (ACBNAME) The name of the local LU to delete. This must match an existing LU name defined with LUADD. The name must be 1-8 alphanumeric characters.

persist_sessions.description: (PERSIST/NOPERSIST) Indicates whether APPC/MVS should deactivate persistent sessions between the LU and its partners. When true (PERSIST), persistent sessions remain active. When false (NOPERSIST), persistent sessions are deactivated.

sideinfo_statement.description: (SIDEINFO) statement specifies the VSAM key sequenced data set (KSDS) in which side information entries are kept. Only one side information file is allowed per z/OS system. The VSAM file must be previously defined and cataloged in either a user catalog or the master catalog. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=appcpmxx-specifying-vsam-ksds-side-information-sideinfo-statement

dataset_name.description: (DATASET) The name of the VSAM KSDS dataset that contains side information entries. The dataset must be a VSAM KSDS and must be cataloged. For a sample VSAM file definition, see SYS1.SAMPLIB member ATBSIVSM.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Gen.description: The virtual lookaside facility (VLF) enables an authorized program to store named objects in virtual storage managed by VLF and to retrieve these objects by name on behalf of users in multiple address spaces. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-statements-cofvlfxx

class_name.description: (NAME) The name of the VLF class. IBM-supplied VLF class names begin with the letters A through I. Installation-supplied class names must begin with the letters J-Z or @, #, or $. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-statements-cofvlfxx

alert_age.description: (ALERTAGE) The age, in seconds, for objects in the specified class. The IBM Health Checker for z/OS check IBMVLF, VLF_MAXVIRT uses the ALERTAGE to determine whether objects are being trimmed too rapidly to meet the installation's usage goals for VLF. The higher the ALERTAGE value you specify, the more likely it is that the VLF_MAXVIRT check will issue an exception message. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-statements-cofvlfxx

eligible_mvs_directories_list.description: (EDSN) The list of MVS directories whose MVS files are eligible to be the source for VLF objects in the class. For a PDS class, EDSN identifies a partitioned data set name whose members are eligible to be the source for VLF objects in the class. Do not use the EDSN parameter and the EMAJ parameter on the same CLASS statement. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-statements-cofvlfxx

dataset_name.description: The name of the MVS directory (data set name). The dsn can be 1 to 44 alphanumeric characters, including @, #, $, and periods (.).

resident_volume.description: (VOL) The volume in which the data set is found. You do not need to specify the volume if the cataloged data set is the desired one. If the data set is not cataloged, or if you have multiple data sets with the same name on different volumes, you must specify VOL. The vol can be any combination of alphanumeric characters, including @, #, and $, or a dash (-).

eligible_major_name.description: (EMAJ) Eligible major names for a non-PDS class. The major name does not correspond to a partitioned data set. Do not use with EDSN parameter. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-statements-cofvlfxx

maximum_amount_of_virtual_storage.description: (MAXVIRT) The maximum number of 4K blocks of virtual storage that VLF can use to store objects for the class. The value must be a decimal number from 256 through 524288. You can specify up to six digits, including leading zeros. The maximum value is the maximum data space size. If the system cannot obtain the amount of storage that is specified on MAXVIRT, it obtains as much as possible. VLF trims least frequently used objects when the amount of storage that is used for a class approaches 90 percent of its MAXVIRT value. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-statements-cofvlfxx

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Gen.description: Schema for ASCHPMxx parmlib member - APPC/MVS transaction scheduler class definitions. Defines classes of transaction initiators, default options, and TP profile defaults for the APPC/MVS transaction scheduler. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=sys1parmlib-aschpmxx-appcmvs-transaction-scheduler

class_add.description: Define classes of transaction initiators for the APPC/MVS transaction scheduler. Each class defines characteristics such as minimum/maximum initiators, response goals, and message limits. At least one class definition is required for work assigned to the scheduler.

class_name.description: (CLASSNAME) Name of the scheduler class. A 1- to 8-byte string of uppercase letters A-Z, numerals 0-9, and national characters (@, $, #). Must begin with an alphabetic or national character.

minimum_initiators.description: (MIN) Minimum number of transaction initiators brought up for this class when the ASCH address space starts or changes dynamically. The number of initiators never drops below this value. Value range: 0 - 64000. Default: 0.

maximum_initiators.description: (MAX) Maximum number of transaction initiators allowed for this class. After this limit is reached, incoming requests are queued. Value range: 1 - 64000. Default: 1.

response_goal.description: (RESPGOAL) Response time goal in seconds for transaction programs in this class. The scheduler creates additional initiators up to MAX to meet this goal. Value range: 0.000001 - 31536000 seconds (365 days). Default: 1.

message_limit.description: (MSGLIMIT) Maximum number of messages written to the TP message log each time the transaction program runs within this class. Value range: 1 - 15000. Default: 500.

class_delete.description: Delete classes of transaction initiators from the APPC/MVS transaction scheduler. One CLASSDEL statement must be specified for each class to be deleted.

class_name.description: (CLASSNAME) Name of the existing scheduler class to delete. A 1- to 8-byte string of uppercase letters A-Z, numerals 0-9, and national characters (@, $, #). Must begin with an alphabetic or national character.

work_queue_action.description: (WORKQ) Specifies whether the system drains or purges the work queue when deleting the class. DRAIN: new work is rejected but work already assigned is allowed to finish. PURGE: all queued work is rejected; only running work completes. Default: DRAIN.

options.description: Define default options for the APPC/MVS transaction scheduler. When more than one OPTIONS statement exists in cumulative processing, the most recently processed parameter values are in effect.

default_class.description: (DEFAULT) Default class for transaction programs that do not specify a class in their TP profile. Specify empty string to delete a previously defined default. Value range: null or a 1- to 8-byte string of uppercase letters A-Z, 0-9, national (@, $, #), beginning with alphabetic or national character.

subsystem_name.description: (SUBSYS) Name of the subsystem under which all newly created APPC/MVS transaction initiators are started. Specify empty string to delete a previously defined subsystem. Value range: null or 1- to 4-characters, beginning with alphabetic or national character (@, $, #), remaining characters alphanumeric or national. Default: primary JES subsystem.

tp_defaults.description: Supply default scheduling information when it is missing from the scheduler JCL section of a TP profile. These defaults apply only to transaction programs scheduled by the APPC/MVS transaction scheduler.

region_size.description: (REGION) Default region size assigned to TP profiles that do not specify a region size. Specify as a number (0-9999) followed by K (kilobytes) or M (megabytes, 0-2047), e.g., '64M' or '4096K'. Default: 2M.

oneOf.description: No CPU time limit (equivalent to TIME(1440))
CPU time limit in minutes only. Value range: 1 - 1440.
CPU time limit as 'minutes,seconds' or ',seconds' format. Minutes: 1-1440, seconds: 1-59. Omit minutes for seconds-only (e.g., ',30').

cpu_time_limit.description: (TIME) Default step time limit for TPs that do not specify a time limit. Formats: NOLIMIT, minutes (1-1440), minutes,seconds, or ,seconds. TIME(NOLIMIT) is equivalent to TIME(1440). Default: 1440.

generate_messages_only_on_abend.description: (MSGLEVEL - Boolean) Level of messages generated for TPs in the format MSGLEVEL(1,n). true = only on abnormal termination, false = always generated. Default: false.

output_class.description: (OUTCLASS) Default value for MSGCLASS when MSGCLASS is not specified on the JOB statement in the TP profile. Value range: A-Z, 0-9. Default: A.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Gen.description: Schema for EXSPATxx (Excessive Spin Condition Actions) parmlib member. Controls system recovery actions for excessive spin loop conditions. Syntax rules: SPINRCVY or SPINTIME must start in columns 1-71 and must be the first entry on a record. Comments begin with /* and end with */ and may appear in columns 1-71. Columns 72-80 are ignored by the system. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=actions-syntax-rules-exspatxx

spin_recovery_actions.description: (SPINRCVY) Specifies the recovery actions that the system is to take to end a spin loop that is not caused by a SIGP failure. SPINRCVY must be the first entry on a record. At least one action is required; maximum of eight actions. Any number of blanks may appear between SPINRCVY and the first action. Multiple actions must be separated by commas — a blank is NOT a valid delimiter between actions. All actions must appear on the same logical record as SPINRCVY. Actions: ABEND - Abnormally end unit of work (abend X'071'), allow retry; ACR - Invoke Alternate CPU Recovery, take processor offline; OPER - Issue message IEE331A for operator response; SPIN - Continue spinning, display informational message IEE178I; TERM - Abnormally end unit of work (abend X'071'), no retry. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=actions-statements-parameters-exspatxx

spin_timeout_seconds.description: (SPINTIME) Specifies the excessive spin loop timeout interval in seconds (1-3 digits, minimum 10, maximum 999). SPINTIME=sss must not contain blanks. SPINTIME must be the first entry on a record. Default is 10 seconds for MVS in native/basic mode or LPAR with dedicated CPs; 40 seconds for MVS on VM or in an LPAR with shared CPs. The specified SPINTIME value affects the default value of the INTERVAL parameter in the COUPLExx member. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=actions-statements-parameters-exspatxx

sysplex_name.description: (SYSPLEX) Sysplex name filter for subsequent statements. Supports wildcards. Default is '*' (all sysplexes). https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=configuration-statements-parameters-iefopzxx

keep_valid_on_error.description: (KEEPONERROR) Error handling behavior. When true (VALID), keeps valid statements on error. When false (NONE), discards all statements on error. Default varies by invocation method. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=configuration-statements-parameters-iefopzxx

validation_mode.description: (CHECKALL/CHECKACTIVE) Data set validation mode. CHECKALL validates all IEFOPZ-Old and IEFOPZ-New data sets. CHECKACTIVE validates only active data sets. Default is CHECKALL. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=configuration-statements-parameters-iefopzxx

owner_minimum_architecture_pairs.description: (OWNER/MINARCH) Owner-specific minimum architecture level specifications. Each entry pairs an owner name with their minimum required architecture level. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=configuration-statements-parameters-iefopzxx

owner.description: (OWNER) Owner name. Supports wildcards. Can contain embedded blanks if quoted. Alphanumeric, national, period, and underscore characters allowed.

minimum_architecture_level.description: (MINARCH) Minimum architecture level for this owner. Valid range is 8-99.

old_new_library_pairs.description: (OLDNEW) Old/New load library optimization pairings. new_libraries.description: (NEW) Optimized load library specifications. At least one required. Each must have a unique architecture level.

dataset_name.description: (DSNAME/DSN) Data set name of the optimized library. Must not match any IEFOPZ-Old data set or PROGxx SYSLIB data sets.

architecture_level.description: (ARCH) Architecture level for this optimized library. Must be unique within this OLDNEW pairing. Valid range is 8-99 (8=z10, 9=z196, 10=zEC12, 11=z13, 12=z14, 13=z15).

dataset_name.description: (DSNAME/DSN) Data set name of the optimized library. Must not match any IEFOPZ-Old data set or PROGxx SYSLIB data sets.

volume.description: (VOLUME/VOLSER/VOL) Volume serial number. Use '*MCAT*' for IPL-time master catalog volume. If omitted, catalog is used to determine volume.

include_members.description: (INCLUDEMEMBERS/IMEM/INCLUDEMEM/INCLUDEMEMBER) Member names to include from the old library. Supports wildcards. Default is to process all members.

exclude_members.description: (EXCLUDEMEMBERS/EMEM/EXCLUDEMEM/EXCLUDEMEMBER) Member names to exclude from the old library. Supports wildcards. Applied after include_members. Members in both lists are excluded.

active.description: (ACTIVE/INACTIVE) Whether this Old/New pairing is active. When true (ACTIVE), the pairing is used. When false (INACTIVE), the pairing is not used. Default is true.

ddname_jobname_pairs.description: (DDNAME/JOBNAME) DDNAME and JOBNAME pairs for OLDNEW processing. Specifies which DDNAMEs and JOBNAMEs should be processed. Default is to process JOBLIB and STEPLIB only. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=configuration-statements-parameters-iefopzxx

enable_lla_processing.description: (LLA) Enable automatic IEFOPZ processing for Library Lookaside (LLA). When true (YES), LLA processing is enabled. When false (NO), LLA processing is disabled. Default is true. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=configuration-statements-parameters-iefopzxx

enable_lnklst_processing.description: (LNKLST) Enable automatic IEFOPZ processing for LNKLST. When true (YES), LNKLST processing is enabled. When false (NO), LNKLST processing is disabled. Default is true. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=configuration-statements-parameters-iefopzxx

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Gen.description: XCF PR/SM Policy - In a multisystem sysplex on PR/SM, the XCF PR/SM policy provides a way for the installation to obtain high availability for multisystem applications on the MVS systems in the sysplex. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=sys1parmlib-xcfpolxx-xcf-prsm-policy

status_update_missing_policies.description: NOSTATUS statements - Specifies actions to take when specified systems appear to have failed (status update missing).

failed_system.description: (failsys) The system name that appears to have failed. The current system and the failing system must be running in LPAR mode on the same processor.

reset_time_seconds.description: (RESETTIME) Specifies that the failing system is to be reset after the specified number of seconds have elapsed. If the failing system becomes active before the specified time interval elapses, the system reset is not performed. Specify a time interval of less than 60 seconds because longer intervals might cause SETXCF PRSMPOLICY commands to be delayed.

deactivate_time_seconds.description: (DEACTTIME) Specifies that the logical partition (LPAR) where the failing system resides is to be deactivated after the specified number of seconds have elapsed. Specifying DEACTTIME also causes the system to be reset. If the failing system becomes active before the specified time interval elapses, the LPAR is not deactivated. Specify a time interval of less than 60 seconds because longer intervals might cause SETXCF PRSMPOLICY commands to be delayed.

system_gone_policies.description: SYSGONE statements - Specifies actions to take when the specified system was reset by the operator or by the policy specified by the NOSTATUS parameter.

failed_system.description: (failsys) The system name that was reset. The specified system must be in the same sysplex as the current system and on the same processor as the system specified with owning_system.

owning_system.description: (SYSTEM) Identifies the system in the sysplex that is to take the deactivation actions when the failed_system failed. The system indicated is not necessarily the current system. Instead, it is the system that you are designating to perform the deactivation of the LPAR. This allows a single XCFPOLxx parmlib member to be used on all systems in the sysplex.

deactivate_system.description: (DEACTIVATE) Specifies either that the logical partition (LPAR) where the specified system (othersys) resides is to be deactivated or all LPARs within the current system's addressing range are to be deactivated. Specify a system name or 'ALL' to deactivate all LPARs. Note: Specifying DEACTIVATE(othersys) where othersys is the same system specified in NOSTATUS with RESETTIME has no effect; use DEACTTIME instead.

acquire_storage.description: (STORE) Specifies whether the owning_system is to acquire the storage that is freed up by the deactivated LPARs.

acquire_expanded_storage.description: (ESTORE) Specifies whether the owning_system is to acquire the expanded storage that is freed up by the deactivated LPARs. Note: ESTORE is not supported in the z/Architecture environment.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Gen.description: Schema for IFAPRDxx parmlib member that defines product enablement policies. Uses HIERARCHY pattern where WHEN statements create environmental contexts for PRODUCT statements. Documentation: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=sys1parmlib-ifaprdxx-product-enablement-policy

when_contexts.description: Array of WHEN contexts, each defining an environmental scope for product enablement policies. Order matters: first match wins after priority rules. Initial state is TRUE (implicit WHEN() before first explicit WHEN).

items.description: A WHEN context that defines environmental scope for product statements. WHEN parameters are optional (omitted parameters match any value). PRODUCT statements inherit the environment from this WHEN context.

when_parameters.description: Optional environmental parameters that define when this context applies. All parameters support wildcard matching (* and ?). Omitted object represents implicit WHEN() which is always TRUE.

lparname.description: (LPARNAME) Name of logical partition defined through HCD or IOCP. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any LPAR name). Empty string matches only when not running in LPAR.

sysname.description: (SYSNAME) System name. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any system name).

sysplex.description: (SYSPLEX) Sysplex name. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any sysplex name).

hwname.description: (HWNAME) Hardware name (CPC identifier) defined to HCD. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any hardware name). Empty string matches only when hardware name not known.

vmuserid.description: (VMUSERID) z/VM user ID under which z/OS runs as guest. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any z/VM user ID). Empty string matches only when not running as z/VM guest.

product_statements.description: Array of PRODUCT statements that apply within this WHEN context. Order matters: first match wins after exact-match and priority rules. Each product must specify STATE (required).

items.description: Defines a product and its enablement state. Matching uses priority order (OWNER highest, MOD lowest) with exact match beating wildcard. Omitted parameters default to * (match any).

owner.description: (OWNER) Product owner name (e.g., 'IBM CORP'). Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any owner). Matching priority: 1 (highest). Underscores translated to blanks for comparison. Uppercase comparison. Quote if lowercase, embedded blanks, or special characters.

id.description: (ID) Product identifier. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any ID). Matching priority: 2. Underscores translated to blanks for comparison. Uppercase comparison. Quote if lowercase, embedded blanks, or special characters.

name.description: (NAME) Product name. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any name). Matching priority: 3. Underscores translated to blanks for comparison. Uppercase comparison. Quote if lowercase, embedded blanks, or special characters.

featurename.description: (FEATURENAME, FN) Name of product feature. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any feature). Matching priority: 4. Underscores translated to blanks for comparison. Uppercase comparison. Quote if lowercase, embedded blanks, or special characters.

version.description: (VERSION, VER, VERS) Product version. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any version). Matching priority: 5. Alphabetic or numeric only. Uppercase comparison. Quote if lowercase or special characters. For z/OS features, omit or specify *.

release.description: (RELEASE, REL) Product release number. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any release). Matching priority: 6. Alphabetic or numeric only. Uppercase comparison. Quote if lowercase or special characters. For z/OS features, omit or specify *.

mod.description: (MOD) Product modification level. Supports wildcards (* and ?). Default: * (matches any modification). Matching priority: 7 (lowest). Alphabetic or numeric only. Uppercase comparison. Quote if lowercase or special characters. For z/OS features, omit or specify *.

state.description: (STATE) Enablement state of the product. Required parameter. ENABLED (EN): product can continue to run. DISABLED (DI, DIS): product is not to continue. NOTDEFINED (ND): remove product from policy.

maximum_total_reader_tasks.description: (MaxTotalReaderTasks) The limit on the number of active LSS and SCID combinations in a XRC session.

maximum_tracks_formatted.description: (MaxTracksFormatted) The maximum number of record sets that are read in a single channel program.

maximum_number_of_records_read_in_a_reco.description: (MaxTracksRead) The maximum number of record sets that are read in a single channel program.

maximum_number_of_tracks_updated_in_a_re.description: (MaxTracksUpdated) Restricts the number of tracks being updated in a single write record set channel program.

waiting_period_before_error_message_antx.description: (NoTimeStampCount) The waiting period before XRC issues message ANTX8030W.

number_of_reader_tasks.description: (NumberReaderTasks) Specifies whether auxiliary readers are to be used and the number of the auxiliary readers.

pacing_report_threshold.description: (PacingReportThreshold) The number of milliseconds of injected write pacing, per write I/O, that must exist for a write pacing-enabled volume to be flagged as 'blocked' in XQUERY reports and XRC monitor data.

parallel_access_volume_byte_threshold.description: (PavByteThreshold) The number of bytes used to determine when write I/O for a secondary device is to be split into multiple tasks.

number_of_parallel_access_volumes.description: (PavVolumes) The number of parallel write I/O tasks to be used when PavBytesThreshold is exceeded for a given secondary device in a consistency group.

read_cache_check_delay.description: (ReadDelay) the frequency that XRC checks to see if there are record sets in cache. You can specify a value between 100 and 5000. The value is in milliseconds with a default of 1000 (one second).

percent_reader_pacing_limit.description: (ReaderPacingLimit) Dynamically reduces the effective reader pacing window after 'leading' readers have accumulated updates in the specified percentage of available data mover buffers.

reader_pacing_window.description: (ReaderPacingWindow) Limits the extent to which the data mover can 'read ahead' (in seconds) in a given session.

dispatching_priority_for_record_reads.description: (ReadRecordsPriority) The dispatching priority for read record sets.

dispatching_priority_for_record_writes.description: (WriteRecordsPriority) The dispatching priority for writing record sets to a secondary volume.

remote_pair_flash_copy.description: (RemotePairFlashCopy) Remote Pair FlashCopy support should be enabled for the specified XRC session.

require_utility.description: (RequireUtility) Prevent XADDPAIR of a non-XRCUTL when an active storage control session does not exist for the specified (or default) SCSESSION.

minimum_residual_left_to_read.description: (ResidualLeftToRead) The smallest number of remaining record sets that causes XRC to perform another read.

schedule_verify.description: (ScheduleVerify) The data mover should periodically schedules mirror status verification.

storage_schedule_timeout.description: (StorageControlTimeout) The primary storage control timeout value for application impact.

suspend_on_long_busy.description: (SuspendOnLongBusy) Enable Suspend on Long Busy function when a new storage control session is added.

utility_device.description: (UtilityDevice) The method used for selecting a utility device.

verify_interval_in_hours.description: (VerifyInterval) The interval, in hours, between the scheduled verifications.

write_pacing_residual_count.description: (WrtPacingResidualCnt) This value is multiplied by 64 to determine a target device residual count, at which the maximum permissible pacing will be injected for a given write pacing-enabled volume.

startup.description: (STARTUP) Settings used when starting up extended Remote Copy Services

cluster_master_session.description: (ClusterMSession) Specify the XRC master session name to be associated with a cluster session.

cluster_name.description: (ClusterName) The XRC cluster session name to be used in a logical partition.

registry_member_containing_parameters.description: (Global) The mvs file containing XRC registry parameters which are applied to all XRC sessions when started using the XSTART command.

mvs_directory_high_level_qualifier.description: (Hlq) The high-level qualifier for mvs directory.

maximum_number_of_control_tasks.description: (MaxControlTasks) Te number of tasks available in the ANTAS000 address space for the parallel processing of the XRC and PPRC requests

message_volume_format.description: (MessageVolumeFormat) Control how volumes are identified in messages.

master_mvs_directory_high_level_qualifie.description: (MHlq) The high-level qualifier for the master mvs directory.

registry_mvs_directory.description: (Parmlib) Which mvs directories to use when searching for members that contain registry information.

sessions.description: (Session) A list of session id's and related registry member containing configuration information.

related_member.description: The configuration registry member associated with the session.

suppress_time_stamp.description: (SupressTimeStamp) Suppress channel program timestamping on XRC system data mover systems.

ziip_enable.description: (zIIPEnable) Specifies whether the ANTAS000, ANTAS0nn, and ANTCL0nn address spaces are enabled for running on zIIP processors.

x_start_query.description: (xStartQuery) Specifies whether or not the specified XQUERY will be issued at XSTART.

storage.description: Define the amount of storage that is used in various operations.

buffers_per_storage_control.description: (BuffersPerStorageControl) How many buffers XRC allocates per scsession specified.

permanent_fixed_pages.description: (PermanentFixedPages) The maximum amount of real storage, in MB, that XRC keeps page fixed to process I/O operations.

released_fixed_pages.description: (ReleaseFixedPages) Free up pages of storage that are not being used.

total_buffers.description: (TotalBuffers) The maximum number of buffers used for an XRC session.

input_output_data_areas.description: (IODataAreas) The real storage allocation for XRC channel programs and work areas that are associated with I/O operations.

volume_synchronization.description: Volume synchronization and resynchronization is the process of copying data from a primary volume to the secondary volume with which it has been associated.

enable_refreshes.description: (EnableRefreshs) The TSO XSET REFRESHS command is enabled for execution.

initialization_method.description: (InitializationMethod) The extent to which the primary volume is copied to the secondary volume.

initializations_per_primary.description: (InitializationsPerPrimary) The maximum number of primary volume synchronizations and resynchronizations that can occur concurrently on a single storage control.

initializations_per_secondary.description: (InitializationsPerSecondary) The maximum number of secondary volume synchronizations and resynchronizations that can occur concurrently on a single storage control.

halt_any_init.description: (HaltAnyInit) Pauses volume initialization if the record set residual count rises above the HaltThreshold value on any storage control, rather than just the storage control with which the primary volume is associated.

halt_threshold.description: (HaltThreshold) Stops volume synchronizations or resynchronizations if the record set residual count of the storage control associated with a volume reaches this threshold value.

maximum_number_of_initializations.description: (MaxNumberInitializations) The number of volume synchronizations and resynchronizations that can occur simultaneously in an XRC session.

selection_algorithm.description: (SelectionAlgorithm) The method the system data mover should use when choosing the next volume pair to be synchronized or resynchronized.

number_of_tracks_per_read.description: (TracksPerRead) If 1-15 are specified it is number of tracks to read in one channel program. Otherwise it is the number of channel command words in one channel program.

number_of_tracks_per_write.description: (TracksPerWrite) If 1-15 are specified, he number of tracks to written in one channel program. Otherwise it is the number of channel command words in one channel program.

list_of_secondary_device_ranges.description: (SecondaryDeviceRange) Specifies whether a secondary device range filter should be used and if so, the list of device ranges to use.

secondary_volume_and_serial_number_patte.description: (SecondaryVolserPattern) Specifies whether a secondary VOLSER pattern filter should be used and if so, the list of VOLSER patterns to use.

wlm_report_abnormal_termination.description: (ABNORMALTERM) Abnormal terminations that are reported by the WLM report service IWMRPT for a server are included when computing the weight of the routing service IWM4SRSC that is called for the server.

capacity_limit_enforced_permanently.description: (ABSMSUCAPPING) The defined capacity limit or group capacity limit is to be enforced only while the long term four-hour rolling average consumption is greater than or equal to the defined limit, or if it should always be enforced.

ai_managed_workload_manager.description: (AIMANAGEMENT) WLM is to use artificial intelligence (AI) for WLM-managed batch initiators for all service classes that are enabled for AI.

blocked_workload_wait_threshold.description: (BLWLINTHD) The threshold time interval in seconds for which a blocked address space or enclave must wait before being considered for promotion.

cpu_capacity_devoted_to_blocked_workload.description: (BLWLTRPCT) How much of the CPU capacity is to be used to promote blocked workloads.

minimum_mean_time_to_wait_threshold.description: (CCCSIGUR) The minimum mean-time-to-wait threshold value for heavy CPU users.

cpu_protection_for_implicit_work.description: (CCImp) Specifies how CPU protection is implicitly assigned to work.

cpu_protection_for_implicit_work_during_.description: (CCImpBoost) Specifies how CPU protection is implicitly assigned to work.

clist_commands_as_separate_commands.description: The individual commands in a TSO/E CLIST are treated as separate commands for transaction control.

io_interruptions_thresholds.description: (CPENABLE) Specifies the low (ICCTPILO) and high (ICCTPIHI) threshold values for the percentage of I/O interruptions to be processed through the test pending interrupt (TPI) instruction path in IOS.

mpl_thresholds_16m.description: (RCCFXET) SRM uses these thresholds to determine whether the system MPL needs to be increased or decreased based on the first 16 MB

mpl_thresholds.description: (RCCFXTT) SRM uses these thresholds to determine whether the system MPL needs to be increased or decreased.

directed_virtual_io_enabled.description: (DVIO) Make directed VIO active in the system

enqueue_service_unit_consumption.description: (ERV) The number of CPU service units that an address space or enclave is allowed to absorb when it is possibly causing enqueue contention.

allow_service_request_manager_preemption.description: (FULLPRESYSTEM) Allow SRM full preemption for the system address spaces.

general_purpose_processors_help_ziip.description: (IIPHONORPRIORITY) Let zIIP processors get help from general purpose processors (CPs) when there is insufficient capacity for the workload demand.

general_purpose_processors_help_zaap.description: (IFAHONORPRIORITY) Let zAAP processors get help from general purpose processors (CPs) when there is insufficient capacity for the workload demand.

initiator_priority.description: (INITIMP) Specifies the dispatching priority for batch, APPC, and OMVS initiators.

percentage_of_real_storage_below_16m_cau.description: (IRA405I(0))Specifies the percentage of the fixed storage that causes the system to issue message IRA405I.

percentage_of_real_storage_between_16m_a.description: (IRA405I(1))Specifies the percentage of the fixed storage that causes the system to issue message IRA405I.

percentage_of_total_real_storage_causing.description: (IRA405I(2))Specifies the percentage of the fixed storage that causes the system to issue message IRA405I.

manage_non_enclave_work.description: (MANAGENONENCLAVEWORK) Specifies whether non-enclave transaction work of queue servers and enclave servers is to be managed or not.

maximum_promote_time.description: (MAXPROMOTETIME) The time during which a resource holder is allowed to run promoted when it is possibly causing a resource contention.

storage_stealing_thresholds.description: (MCCAFCTH) Specifies the threshold values for storage. Begin indicates the number of frames on the available frame queue when stealing begins. End indicates the number of frames on the available frame queue when stealing ends. If the lowvalue or okvalue is below the default value, the default value is enforced.

fixed_storage_percentage_in_the_first_16.description: (MCCFXEPR) The percentage of storage that is fixed within the first 16 megabytes.

fixed_online_storage_percentage.description: (MCCFXTPR) The percentage of online storage that might be fixed.

general_purpose_processor_multi_threaded.description: (MT_CP_MODE) Specifies the multithreading (MT) mode, which is the number of active threads per core for all online cores with a core type of general purpose processor.

ziip_processor_multi_threaded_mode.description: (MT_ZIIP_MODE) Specifies the multithreading (MT) mode, which is the number of active threads per core for all online cores with a core type of general purpose processor.

activate_cpu_projection.description: (PROJECTCPU) Specifies whether to activate or deactivate the projection of how work could be offloaded from general purpose processors (CPs) to IBM z Integrated Information Processors (zIIP).

lead_time_to_reduce_routing_weights_when.description: (RTBELEADTIME) How far in advance (x minutes) of the end of the IPL Boost period WLM's sysplex routing recommendations reduce the routing weight.

soft_capping_lead_time.description: (RTCAPLEADTIME) How far in advance an upcoming soft capping should influence WLM's sysplex routing recommendations.

performance_index_weighting_factor.description: (RTPIFACTOR) How much the server performance index (PI) should affect the server routing weights returned by WLM services

alternate_wait_management_ziip.description: (ZIIPAWMT) Specifies an Alternate Wait Management (AWM) value for the IBM z Integrated Information Processor (zIIP) to minimize SRM and LPAR low utilization effects and overheads

alternate_wait_management_zaap.description: (ZAAPAWMT) Specifies an Alternate Wait Management (AWM) value for the IBM zAAP to minimize SRM and LPAR low utilization effects and overheads

alternate_wait_management.description: (CCCAWMT) Specifies whether to activate or deactivate Alternate Wait Management (AWM)

select_non_swappable_address_spaces.description: (STORAGENSWDP) The system should select non-swappable address spaces to resolve a storage shortage.

pass_service_class_goals_to_storage_prio.description: (STORAGESERVERMGT) Specifies whether SRM should pass service class importance and goal information to the storage I/O priority manager in the IBM System Storage DS8000® series.

warn_of_storage_issues_via_the_console.description: (STORAGEWTOR) How the system handles address spaces in a critical storage shortage.

suppress_security_informational_messages.description: (SUPPSAFINFOMSG) SAF informational messages issued for successful completion of RACROUTE invocations in the WLM Begin Server Transaction (IWM4STBG) service should be suppressed.

time_slices.description: (TIMESLICES) The number of time slices that a CPU-intensive address space or enclave with a discretionary goal should be given before a dispatchable unit of equal importance is dispatched.

vary_cpu_management_available.description: (VARYCPU) Specifies whether LPAR Vary CPU management is available or not available.

minimum_number_of_processors.description: (VARYCPUMIN) The minimum number of processors that must stay online during WLM LPAR management.

use_wlm_websphere_routing.description: (WASROUTINGLEVEL) The routing algorithm that is used by the WLM WebSphere® routing services.

intelligent_resource_director_structure_.description: (WLMIRDSTRUC) The IRD coupling facility structure the system attempts to connect at IPL time.

global_resource_serialization.description: (ENQ) Global resource serialization control blocks for the task.

recovery_termination.description: (ERR) Recovery termination control blocks (RTM2WA, registers from the SDWA, SCB, EED) for the task.

io_subsystem.description: (IO) IOS control blocks (UCB, EXCPD) for the task.

local_system_queue_area.description: (LSQA) Local system queue area for the address space. If storage is allocated for subpools 229, 230 and 249, they are dumped for the current task.

no_symptom_dump.description: (NOSYM) No symptom dump is to be produced.

nucleus.description: (NUC) Read/write portion of the control program nucleus. SQA, LSQA, and the PSA are included.

job_pack_areas.description: (JPA) Contents of the job pack area that relate to the failing task. These include module names and contents.

save_area_with_backward_trace.description: (SA) Save area linkage information and a backward trace of save areas.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Gen.title: GRSMONxx Configuration Schema
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Gen.description: Schema for GRSMONxx (Global Resource Serialization Monitor) parmlib member. Defines filters for monitoring ENQ, DEQ, GQSCAN, and ISGQUERY requests. Documentation: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=sys1parmlib-grsmonxx-global-resource-serialization-monitor

filters.description: List of filter statements that define monitoring criteria. Filters are processed in order, with INCLUDE filters checked first, then EXCLUDE filters. For a filter to match, all specified parameters must match (logical AND).

oneOf.description: Filter for ENQ request type. Monitors ENQ (ENQ, RESERVE, or ISGENQ REQUEST=OBTAIN) requests.

include_filter.description: (INCLUDE/EXCLUDE) Specifies whether to include or exclude matching requests from monitoring. True includes requests, false excludes them.

type.description: (ENQ) Specifies the type of request to match. ENQ matches ENQ/RESERVE/ISGENQ REQUEST=OBTAIN requests.

qname.description: (QNAME) Specifies the QNAME value to match on ENQ, RESERVE, or ISGENQ macros. Supports wildcard characters (* and ?) and quoted strings for special characters like blanks.

rname.description: (RNAME) Specifies the RNAME value to match on ENQ, RESERVE, or ISGENQ macros. Supports wildcard characters (* and ?) and quoted strings. Can span multiple lines in parmlib using comma-delimited quoted strings. Must exactly match the RNAME on a request unless wildcards are used.

scope.description: (SCOPE) Specifies the scope type to match after RNL processing. STEP matches step-level scope. SYSTEM matches system-level scope. SYSTEMS matches systems-level scope. ANY matches any scope type.

jobname.description: (JOBNAME) Specifies the JOBNAME of the issuer to match. Supports wildcard characters (* and ?) and quoted strings for special characters like blanks.

reserve.description: (RESERVE) Specifies whether to match requests that resulted in a hardware reserve after RNL processing. YES matches requests that resulted in a hardware reserve. NO matches requests that did not result in a hardware reserve. ANY matches any request.

auth_qlevel.description: (AUTHQLVL) Specifies the Qname authorization level to match. 2 matches requests that would fail at AUTHQLVL 2 (unauthorized requester using authorized Qname). NONE matches any request regardless of authorization level.

enable_tracking.description:
(TRACKING) Enable or disable tracking for the Generic Tracker. 
 true (ON) - Enables tracking. The tracking facility honors GTZTRACK service requests and record data as appropriate. 
 false (OFF) - Disables tracking. The tracking facility ignores all GTZTRACK service requests and does not record any data. Tracking data, GTZPRMxx information, or related statistics are not deleted and will continue to be accumulated after a future TRACKING=ON request. To remove data from the facility, use the CLEAR command. To retrieve any data, use the DISPLAY GTZ command, the GTZQUERY service, or the GTZPRINT utility.

persistence_mode.description:
(PERSIST) Enable or disable persistence of tracking data. 
 false (OFF) - No data persistence (default). 
 true (SMF) - Persist data to SMF records (type 125, subtype 1).

exclude_filters.description:
(EXCLUDE) Tracking instances that should be excluded from recording. Any future GTZTRACK request with data that matches the filter are not recorded, and any matching recorded instances that have been tracked are cleared from the facility. When trackdata comes in, if both an EXCLUDE statement and a DEBUG statement apply, the debug program is triggered and the tracked instance is not recorded.
Duplicate EXCLUDE statements are ignored by the system.

items.description: (EXCLUDE(filter)) Filter to exclude tracked instances from being recorded

event_description.description: (EVENTDESC) Event description pattern to match. The value must be 1-64 characters and can contain wildcard characters anywhere in the string. A question mark (?) matches a single arbitrary character. The value can also contain any EBCDIC character, but not just blanks or just X'00'. IBM recommends using printable character. No blanks are removed. A value of '*' matches any character sequence of zero or more characters.

event_data.description:
(EVENTDATA) To be compared to the EVENTDATA value of a tracked instance as specified on its GTZTRACK request. The EVENTDATA value is interpreted as a 16-byte value. 
 Specify the value of the data to match in one of the following formats: 
 - Hexadecimal using the format 'hhhhhhhh' with hhhh representing 1-32 hexadecimal digits (A-F, a-f, 0-9).
 - Decimal using the format dddddddd with dddddddd representing 1-32 decimal digits. 
 - '*' to match any EVENTDATA value.

event_job.description: (EVENTJOB) To be compared to the event address space job name, as derived from the EVENTASID value of a tracked instance (as specified on its GTZTRACK request). The value must be 1-8 characters. It can contain wildcard characters anywhere in the string. A question mark (?) matches a single arbitrary character. It can only contain alphabetic characters (A-Z, a-z), numerics (0-9), national characters (@ $, #), or wildcard characters. All lowercase characters (a-z) are folded to uppercase (A-Z). A value of '*' matches any character sequence of zero or more characters.

event_asid.description:
(EVENTASID) To be compared to the EVENTASID value of a tracked instance (as specified on its GTZTRACK request). The EVENTASID value is interpreted as a 16-bit binary value.
 Specify the value of the data to match in one of the following formats: 
 - Hexadecimal using the format 'hhhhhhhh' with hhhh representing 1-4 hexadecimal digits (A-F, a-f, 0-9).
 - Decimal using the format dddddddd with dddddddd representing 1-32 decimal digits. 
 - '*' to match any EVENTASID value.

program_type.description: (PROGRAMTYPE) Type of program to filter. NOPATH matches programs without path information, PATH matches programs with path information, ALL matches all program types.

program_name.description: (PROGRAM) Program name pattern to match. Supports wildcards (*) for pattern matching. Example: EZAFTP* matches EZAFTPLS, EZAFTPX, etc.

home_job_name.description: (HOMEJOB) Home job name pattern to match. Supports wildcards (*) for pattern matching. Example: *MASTER* matches any job with MASTER in the name.

home_asid.description:
(HOMEASID) To be compared to the ID of the home address space as derived from the dispatchable unit under which a tracked instance's GTZTRACK request was executed. 16-bit binary value. 
 Specify the value of the data to match in one of the following formats: 
 - Hexadecimal using the format 'hhhhhhhh' with hhhh representing 1-4 hexadecimal digits (A-F, a-f, 0-9).
 - Decimal using the format dddddddd with dddddddd representing 1-32 decimal digits. 
 - '*' to match any HOMEASID value.
